selection_note: Research subset proposed from eligible box support and spatial coverage. Conservation status is not inferred from sample counts and requires a separate authoritative taxonomy/conservation review.
policy: public, non-corrupt metadata; one normalized candidate image label; at least one valid box; all boxes valid and agree with the image label; nonempty sequence and location; group by location
scope: SWG Vietnam and Lao, matching the transboundary Annamites study scope
